_comment: Issue #179, object renames. Every object matches docs/CodingStyle.md after this:
PREFIX_ + SCREAMING_SNAKE, with the prefix naming the kind.
- The 23 documented FB_* blocks. They already comply, which is why the
SCREAMING_SNAKE choice was made: their names are the project's public API,
their doc filenames and every installation's references.
- The 19 MQTT_DISCOVERY_* structs. They are wire format - STRUCT_TO_JSON
publishes their member names as Home Assistant discovery keys - so they are
exempt from the convention both ways. See docs/CodingStyle.md.
- The 12 SFC action names. They already comply, and an SFC chart cannot be
MqttVariables carries "all": true because there are two of them - the G1 lab
application and the G2 verification application each have one, and FB_MQTT_BASE
declares STRING(MqttVariables.MQTT_TOPIC_LEN), so the name has to resolve in
both. Renaming one and not the other would break whichever was left behind.
The two identifier groups are not stylistic tidying, they are prerequisites:
both variables shadow an object about to take their name, and a blind sweep
would rename the variable too - consistently enough to compile. They take the
instance form the convention asks for, which is where they were headed anyway.
